name: r1-geglu-bulkring-s3k8-l
author: solx-loop
description: H12: the L-band read cap (about 5.3 TB/s read-only after the dirty flush) comes from a bytes-in-flight limit on the read side. A persistent 1-D bulk ring (148x8 CTAs, 3 stages of 4 KB gate + 4 KB linear, 192 KB in flight per SM, one instruction per 4 KB) should lift L by at least 3%. Measured: refuted. On the rented B200 the ring is 7-10% slower than r0 at L (full kernel) and 3-5% slower read-only, at every depth tried. Fat threads with all loads issued first tie r0. In-flight bytes do not limit
